schemaVersion: 5 + planner-v2-assignment-facts + schedule-authority-v1 + capture-intake-v1 + homework-analysis-v1 + role-context-v1 + first-journey-v1
notes: Production/main and central TAKY canonical remain unchanged
First Journey now has an explicit welcome layer before role selection for new installs
Guardian-for-child setup is mapped to the parent runtime after onboarding instead of remaining on child defaults
Paid character generation no longer blocks functional onboarding: users may defer character completion and continue through Explorer and first-world selection
Guardian profiles receive a parent/child role switch so setup and child exploration surfaces remain separate
Parent Home now prioritizes timetable confirmation/editing and homework capture/input before Planner allocation
Schedule view exposes timetable add/change and direct homework entry actions for parent runtime
Parent timetable edits use Ready Foundation schedule authority and preserve no-free-time-inference
Homework entry routes to the rapid camera/FACT intake instead of the obsolete camera-gap dialog
Parent homework intake supports rapid camera capture grouped by the six Talent books and capture kind
Captured homework source images are stored locally in IndexedDB readyset_capture_v1 before any remote analysis
A gated /api/homework-analysis endpoint remains available only when READY_HOMEWORK_ANALYSIS_ENABLED=true and OPENAI_API_KEY is configured
AI homework extraction stays pending parent confirmation and never self-promotes to FACT_CONFIRMED
PWA core cache now precaches identity, role, onboarding, Foundation, timetable, homework, Planner, world-shell and parent-setup runtime modules including query-versioned critical boot files
Real iPhone First Journey -> parent setup -> timetable -> homework capture -> Planner -> child-role round trip remains device-validation pending
